name: Extend Help Maintainers
description: Extends module help pages with maintainers info from multiple sources. Plugin-based architecture supports info.yml, drupal.org, and custom fetchers.
project_description: Extend Help Maintainers automatically adds a themed "Maintainers" block to any module's Help page (the core help.page.<module> route). Its hook_help() implementation asks a MaintainersService, which runs a set of pluggable MaintainersFetcher plugins in priority order and merges their results by drupal.org username or name. Two fetchers ship: InfoMaintainersFetcher (priority 100) reads maintainer entries from the target module's .info.yml (extra.extend_help_maintainers.maintainers, or a top-level maintainers key) and optionally scrapes an avatar from the maintainer's drupal.org profile; DrupalOrgMaintainersFetcher (priority 10) scrapes the maintainers block from the module's drupal.org project page and caches it 24h. Each maintainer is a Maintainer DTO (name, drupal_org, avatar) rendered through the extend_help_maintainers theme hook and an all-escaping Twig template with a placeholder avatar fallback. An admin settings form (/admin/config/system/extend-help-maintainers, permission 'administer site configuration') lets administrators choose which fetchers are enabled and override per-plugin priorities. The module requires no other modules and works on Drupal 10 and 11.
